dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit a consistent convex arc with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency distribution of small, light-toned clusters concentrated along the central and left dorsal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the light-toned mottled clusters and the dark-grey baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast, light-colored speckles and point-like markings scattered across the dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct dark, oval recessed feature at the anterior midline (blowhole); no significant shadow-casting traumatic indentations visible.
